profile.name: Kaushal Kalas
profile.title: AI/ML Developer
profile.tagline: What fascinates me about computers is how they operate at a fundamental level using bits and binary. This fascination is what drew me to computer engineering.
about: Curiosity has always been the foundation of my learning journey, inspiring me to explore software development and artificial intelligence.
I aim to apply my technical skills and problem-solving abilities to build solutions while continuously growing as an engineer.
Currently focused on DevOps and Data Engineering. Learning how to take AI/ML systems from trained experiments into deployed, monitored products.

projects.name: PotSpot — Real-time pothole detection & segmentation
projects.description: Fine-tuned a transformer-based RF-DETR SegNano model for real-time pothole detection and instance segmentation across 3 road-anomaly classes (Potholes, Manholes, Unmarked Bumps). Sourced and preprocessed a 1,553-image COCO segmentation dataset via Roboflow API. Model achieves 76% recall on multi-pothole incidents.
projects.problem: Road infrastructure monitoring lacks automated, reliable detection of diverse anomaly types in real-world conditions.

projects.name: Security Guardian — AI security scanner for GitHub PRs
projects.description: Built an AI security scanner agent that automatically scans GitHub pull requests for hardcoded secrets, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, and unsafe code patterns. Implemented severity-based PR blocking (Critical/High findings) with actionable remediation guidance.
projects.problem: Security vulnerabilities and secrets often merge into codebases undetected; developers need automated, contextual feedback at PR time.

projects.name: FitBuddy — Android fitness tracking app
projects.description: Developed an Android fitness tracking application that monitors step count, distance traveled, and calories burned with real-time sensor integration and secure user authentication.
projects.problem: Need for a lightweight, privacy-respecting fitness tracker with accurate sensor integration and seamless auth.
